description: Ask a seller to do something, naming your own amount and how long you expect it to take. Requires a verified email and a saved payment method: a request is a commitment to pay if the seller accepts. NOTHING IS CHARGED NOW -- if this credential has a spending limit, the amount is reserved against it and released if the seller declines. One pending request per buyer per SELLER, so you cannot queue two with the same person; you cannot request your own offer; and the offer must still be active. The request is private between the two of you at every stage.

amount.description: What you will pay, in dollars. Positive. The starting price is a guide, not a floor.

description.description: What you need. Only the seller sees it.

estimated_days.description: How long you expect it to take. A positive whole number.
